title: CrystalAR: Autoregressive Modeling for Symmetric Crystal Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27762v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep generative modeling has achieved remarkable progress in crystal generation. Given the rich symmetries inherent in crystalline structures, recent work has sought to explicitly incorporate space-group symmetry into generative models, enabling more effective exploration of novel symmetry templates. Yet introducing symmetry templates increases the combinatorial complexity of stoichiometric relationships between atomic species and crystallographic sites, while creating a fundamental tension between flexible exploration of discrete crystallographic templates and faithful realization of these templates as continuous three-dimensional structures. To address these challenges, we propose CrystalAR, a unified autoregressive framework that models Wyckoff symmetry templates and complete crystal structures within a single generative sequence. Specifically, CrystalAR reformulates continuous coordinate generation as a symmetry-conditioned hierarchy

translated_title: CrystalAR：面向对称晶体生成的自回归建模
translated_abstract: 深度生成建模在晶体生成领域已取得显著进展。鉴于晶体结构中固有的丰富对称性，近期研究尝试将空间群对称性显式地融入生成模型中，从而更有效地探索新型对称模板。然而，引入对称模板会增加原子种类与晶体学位点之间化学计量关系的组合复杂性，同时在离散晶体学模板的灵活探索与将这些模板忠实地实现为连续三维结构之间造成了根本性的矛盾。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了CrystalAR，这是一个统一的自回归框架，能够在单一生成序列中同时对Wyckoff对称模板和完整晶体结构进行建模。具体而言，CrystalAR将连续坐标生成重新表述为一种以对称性为条件的层次化生成过程
tldr: CrystalAR提出统一的自回归框架，在单一生成序列中同时建模Wyckoff对称模板与完整晶体结构，解决了引入空间群对称性所带来的组合复杂性以及离散模板探索与连续三维结构实现之间的矛盾，实现了对称晶体的高效生成。
en_tdlr: CrystalAR proposes a unified autoregressive framework that models Wyckoff symmetry templates and complete crystal structures within a single generative sequence, resolving the combinatorial complexity and the fundamental tension between discrete template exploration and continuous structure realization for symmetric crystal generation.
